GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 250.1 (8 Oct 47) PM
(SCAPIN-1796)
APO 500
8 October 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Robberies of Houses Occupied by Allied Personnel.
1. The attention of the Japanese Government is invited to the fact that during recent months the number of robberies of house occupied by Allied personnel has materially increased throughout Japan. The protection of Allied personnel and their property from the depredation of criminals is a function of the Japanese Government.
2. It is requested that the Japanese Government take adequate measures to provide proper security for the houses assigned to Allied Personnel.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
